jobs.title: Full-stack developer at Novo Nordisk Engineering
jobs.description:
**Full\-stack developer at Novo Nordisk Engineering**
If you are energized by building modern web applications across front\-end, backend and cloud, and you thrive on turning complex engineering needs into robust digital solutions, we’d love to hear from you.  

**Who we are**
We are a leading pharma engineering company shaping the future of API pharma engineering globally. Leveraging the expertise of 2,000\+ employees across Denmark, India, and the US, we design, build and optimise pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities that are essential to the health and well\-being of patients everywhere.
Our success is driven by passion, innovation, and collaboration — with our customers and across our teams and disciplines. If you share our dedication to a noble cause and our passion for API pharma engineering, then NNE is the place for you.  

  



**About the role**


We are looking for a full\-stack developer to join our system development team in Global IT. As a team, we support NNE’s engineering project portfolios and build modern web applications that help colleagues work smarter across projects and locations.
  

In this role, you will contribute across the full development lifecycle, from concept and technical design to development, testing, deployment, and operation.
  

You will work alongside engineers, supporters and developers, take ownership of what you build, and help shape scalable, maintainable technical solutions. You will also review the work of peers across seniority levels and support knowledge sharing with less experienced colleagues.  

**Location** Denmark \- Virum
  

**Experience** Minimum 2 Years
  

**Department** Global IT  

  

**How you might spend your days**
As a full\-stack developer you’ll be:
* Designing, building and maintaining modern web applications, APIs and services for NNE’s engineering project portfolios
* Contributing end\-to\-end from concept and technical design through development, testing, deployment and operation
* Collaborating with engineers, supporters, and developers to translate business needs into scalable, maintainable solutions
* Shaping technical designs, reviewing code and helping improve quality, architecture and ways of working
* Supporting upskilling and sharing knowledge with junior colleagues and peers

**Who you are**
We care about who you are as a person. In the end, how you work, and your energy is what impacts the results we achieve as a team. As a person, you are:
* Taking ownership of deliverables, plans and prioritizes tasks, and makes sound decisions with limited oversight
* Structured, quality\-focused, and result\-oriented in the way you solve problems and deliver outcomes
* Collaborative and comfortable working with colleagues across disciplines, locations, and cultures
* Curious and proactive in suggesting improvements to tools, processes and technical solutions
* Supportive in code reviews and coaching, and open to learning from mistakes with high spirits and a sense of humor

**What you bring to the role**
In all positions, there are some things that are preferred, and others, a bonus. If you do not meet all the qualifications listed below, you are welcome to offer alternative experience that you think would be valuable in this role:
* You hold a bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Engineering or a related field.
* You have hands\-on backend experience with a modern framework such as .NET, Node.js or Python, including RESTful APIs and common architectural/design patterns.
* You have strong frontend experience with HTML, CSS and JavaScript/TypeScript, preferably with React and modern tooling such as Next.js or Vite.
* You have solid experience with relational database design, SQL, and agile practices such as Scrum or Kanban.
* You have experience with Git, CI/CD, automated testing, and cloud\-based application development, preferably on Microsoft Azure.

It is a bonus if you have experience with containerization, NoSQL databases, ORM tools, message queues or event\-driven architectures, or integrating AI capabilities into applications such as LLM APIs, RAG, agentic workflows or MCP servers.  

**Life at NNE**
NNE is short for Novo Nordisk Engineering. And for all of us who work here, NNE means so much more.


At NNE, you become part of a vibrant, project\-based environment built on close day\-to\-day collaboration. The role is therefore primarily on\-site, with physical presence at the workplace expected five days a week. Limited flexibility for occasional remote work may be accommodated in line with business needs.


We are, at our core, a people business and, as such, committed to continuously developing our people and the way we work together. We do not expect you to know it all from day one, and we truly believe a great start makes a real difference. We therefore welcome new colleagues with our award\-nominated onboarding programme, supported by a range of in\-house talent and development initiatives designed to support your long\-term growth.
You can read more about the benefits we offer **here****.**

  

**Did we spark your curiosity? If you’re ready to join our passion, let’s hear from you.**

  

**Deadline of application is** **9th August 2026**

  

Questions before applying? Send us a quick text to arrange a convenient time to chat. Contact Manager, Ivanna Jurkiv Ditlevsen at \+45 3077 4721\.
**Please note:**
* We only accept applications submitted through our online recruitment system
* You do not need to attach a cover letter, but please include a few sentences about why you are applying in your resume or CV
* We invite to interviews on a running basis.

**Fair hiring:**
At NNE, we are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunities for all job applicants. To maintain fairness, we request that you refrain from including a personal photo in your CV.
**Still searching for the right opportunity?**
If this position isn’t quite what you're looking for, but you know someone who would excel in this role, please share this job post. And don’t forget to explore our other exciting opportunities — your future role at NNE might be just around the corner! Visit our Career Site

Software Engineer, C#, Self Protection Mission, Lystrup
Domain Architect til alka.dk (28578)
jobs.description:
Vil du være arkitekten bag den fortsatte udvikling af alka.dk? Vi står foran en modernisering af vores digitale platform, og som Domain Architect får du en central rolle i at definere den tekniske retning og omsætte arkitektur til løsninger, der kan udvikle sig i takt med kundernes forventninger og forretningens ambitioner.


Du bliver en del af vores Arkitekt \& DevOps team, hvor du sparer og sætter retning sammen med de øvrige arkitekter. Men hos os er arkitektur ikke noget, der foregår langt fra udviklingen. Vi tror på, at de bedste arkitekturbeslutninger træffes i tæt dialog med dem, der bygger løsningerne. Derfor er du også synlig i udviklingsteamsene, deltager i tekniske diskussioner og hjælper med at omsætte arkitektur til konkrete løsninger.


**Om jobbet \| Arkitekt med hænderne i teknikken**


Du bliver ansvarlig for arkitekturen bag alka.dk og får stor indflydelse på de tekniske valg, der former platformens videre udvikling. Sammen med udviklingsteamsene og de øvrige arkitekter sikrer du, at løsningerne hænger naturligt sammen på tværs af frontend, integrationslag og vores kerneforsikringssystem – og at de både understøtter en god kundeoplevelse og en robust teknisk platform.


Du kommer til at:


* drive den tekniske retning for alka.dk
* fungere som teknisk sparringspartner for udviklingsteams
* sikre skalerbare, robuste og vedligeholdelsesvenlige løsninger
* facilitere og træffe arkitekturvalg i komplekse problemstillinger sammen med de øvrige arkitekter
* balancere langsigtede arkitekturprincipper med konkrete leverancebehov

**Om dig \| Nysgerrig teamplayer og teknisk stærk sparringspartner**

Du har sandsynligvis en baggrund som Tech Lead, Lead Developer, senior udvikler eller Software Architect og har gerne 3\-5 års erfaring i en arkitekt(\-lignende) rolle. Du trives med at skabe retning uden at miste kontakten til teknikken. Og du motiveres af at indgå i et stærkt team og sparre med udviklere, udfordre designbeslutninger og skabe en arkitektur, der både fungerer i dag og kan udvikle sig i morgen.


Du har erfaring med software\- og løsningsarkitektur på tværs af frontend, integrationer og backend og formår at omsætte komplekse tekniske behov til robuste og skalerbare løsninger. Samtidig følger du udviklingen inden for AI\-teknologier tæt og har erfaring med, eller en stærk interesse for, hvordan AI kan anvendes til at skabe værdi i både softwareudvikling og arkitektur.


Vi forestiller os, at du har erfaring med flere af følgende områder:


* API\-design og moderne integrationsmønstre
* Frontend\-teknologier som JavaScript/TypeScript og Vue.js eller Angular
* CMS\-platforme – gerne Sitecore eller Optimizely
* C\# og Web API'er
* Testautomatisering

Du behøver ikke være frontend\-specialist, men du skal kunne forstå moderne frontend\-arkitektur og være en kvalificeret sparringspartner for udviklerne. Vi forventer desuden, at du tænker sikkerhed ind i løsningerne fra start. Erfaring med DevOps er en fordel, men ikke et krav.


Som person tager du ansvar for retning og fremdrift, og du formår at skabe følgeskab omkring tekniske beslutninger. Du er en stærk kommunikator, der kan gøre komplekse problemstillinger konkrete og forståelige. Du er nysgerrig, pragmatisk og trives i tæt samarbejde med både udviklere og forretning.


**Om os \| En digital udviklingsafdeling med et varmt fællesskab**


Du bliver en del af den agile IT\-organisation Kundevendt Digitalisering med omkring 60 kolleger, herunder udviklingsteams, arkitekter, drift og DevOps\-specialister. Sammen udvikler og driver vi Alkas digitale, kundevendte løsninger.


Vi arbejder agilt i tværfaglige teams med høj grad af autonomi. Arkitekterne er en integreret del af udviklingsorganisationen og spiller en aktiv rolle i de tekniske beslutninger. Vi prioriterer faglig sparring, videndeling og en kultur, hvor gode idéer vejer tungere end titler.


Kulturen er uformel og varm, og vi tror på, at mangfoldighed gør os stærkere.


**Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!**


Lyder det som en rolle, hvor du kan gøre en forskel? Så send din ansøgning og dit CV senest 11\. august 2026\. Vi opfordrer til, at du undlader at vedhæfte billede i dit CV.
  

  

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Enterprise Architect Arnt Christensen på arnt.christensen@alka.dk eller rekrutterende leder Ditte Andersen ditte.a@alka.dk. Da vi er i en sommerperiode, kan du opleve lidt længere svartid.

jobs.title: Database Migrations Engineer
jobs.description:
Laravel is the most popular PHP framework in the world. 500M\+ lifetime downloads. Thousands of packages. A developer community that shows up at conferences, in forums, on Twitter, in Discord servers, in every "what framework should I use?" thread on the internet.


But Laravel is more than a framework. It's a complete platform. From choosing a stack, to building an app, to deploying it, monitoring it, and scaling it. Laravel Cloud is our managed PaaS, and enterprise customers moving onto it face a common, stubborn blocker: database migration. We need someone who solves that problem directly.


Why This Job Is Unique**You will be on calls with enterprise customers and you will run the migration with them.** Not routing tickets. Not advising from a distance. Actually owning the technical execution alongside the customer \- which matters most when we sign a large, impactful contract and need to deliver.

**You are picking up a real, ongoing function.** There is existing database migration work that needs an owner \- including the PlanetScale relationship and recurring ad\-hoc requests scattered across channels. You are not starting from zero.

**The brief is to build the muscle, not wait for the full menu.** Rather than first defining every database we will ever offer, you are the one who develops the function in practice. You’ll be learning what customers need, productising the repeatable parts, and making the case for what comes next.

**You will seed what you know.** The model is "immediate pain relief, then the whole team gets better." Documentation, runbooks, and lightweight training so Sales, CS and engineering compound on your expertise rather than staying dependent on it.


What the Database Migrations Engineer Will Do* **Execute database migrations with enterprise and Private Cloud customers.** Sit on calls, own the technical execution, and deliver successful migrations for customers onboarding to Laravel Cloud \- primarily MySQL and Postgres.
* **Assume ownership of the PlanetScale relationship and migration work.** Take over this function from its current ad\-hoc state and run it cleanly and autonomously.
* **Productise repeatable migration patterns.** Identify the most common downtime\-tolerant migrations and package them \- documentation, decision logic, edge cases \- so they stop being bespoke. We want repeatability over heroics — and with an eye towards eventually bringing that knowledge in\-product, whether through documentation, wizards, or self\-serve flows, so that product\-led customers can benefit too.
* **Automate recurring migration requests.** Map the one\-off requests that surface repeatedly across channels and eliminate the manual effort.
* **Own broader app and service migrations in the gaps.** Act as a generalist migration resource for application and service migrations onto Private Cloud when database migration work permits.
* **Distribute what you learn.** Write clearly. Build runbooks. Create reference material that makes Sales, CS and engineering better without making them dependent on you.
* **Keep the database offering competitive.** Stay close to the market — monitoring what alternatives like PlanetScale, Aurora, and Percona offer in terms of pricing, instance classes, and capabilities. Flag proactively when our offering is out of step with what customers are seeing elsewhere, and advise on what needs to change.

  

**Requirements**  

  

What We Are Looking For* **Genuine strength across both MySQL and Postgres.** We are deliberately optimising for \~80% capability in each over 100% in one. Database specialists tend to plant a flag, and we need coverage across both camps.
* **Direct experience with database migrations in a customer\-facing capacity.** You have been on the calls, you have run the process alongside engineers and customers, and you are comfortable owning the technical execution rather than advising on it.
* **A productisation instinct.** You see the repeatable pattern inside bespoke work and know how to package it without over\-engineering.
* **Strong written and async communication.** We are fully remote and documentation is how knowledge compounds.
* **Comfort operating in a role where part of the scope is yours to define.** There is a clear immediate need, and you will also be shaping what the function looks like from here.


Nice to Have* Experience at a database tooling or infrastructure company \- PlanetScale, Percona, Vitess, or similar
* Experience building tooling or automation around migration workflows
* Familiarity with AWS\-based infrastructure or PaaS environments
* Experience with AWS DMS or comparable migration tooling — DMS has a role in certain migrations and prior use is a strong signal of hands\-on production database migration experience
* A track record of writing, speaking, or teaching publicly about database topics
* Some familiarity with PHP applications

  

**Benefits**  

* Work From Home
* Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental \& Vision)
* Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick \& Public Holidays)
* Family Leave (Maternity, Paternity)
* Stock Option Plan

jobs.title: Senior Scientific Software Developer - Scientific Data Analysis Applications
jobs.description:
**Senior Scientific Software Developer \- Scientific Data Analysis Applications**



The European Spallation Source (ESS) is one of Europe’s largest research infrastructure projects and is building the world’s most powerful neutron source. Through cutting\-edge science and technology, ESS enables discoveries that advance our understanding of materials, energy, health, and the environment.



ESS is expanding the Data Analysis team at the Data Management and Scientific Computing Centre (DMSC), located just north of Copenhagen in Denmark. We are seeking a senior scientific software developer to create analysis applications and researcher\-facing tools for neutron scattering experiments.


**About the team**



We build the analysis applications and libraries scientists use to explore and interpret neutron scattering data. Our work combines scientific methods, instrument expertise, and software engineering to create reliable and user\-friendly tools. We collaborate closely with DMSC developers, ESS instrument scientists, and users from the neutron community. Most of our software is written in Python using the DMSC\-developed EasyScience framework (https://github.com/easyScience). We also contribute to open\-source and cross\-facility projects such as e.g. SasView (https://www.sasview.org).


**About the role**



This is a hands\-on scientific software engineering role focused on interactive data analysis applications and scientific platforms for neutron scattering experiments. Depending on your background and interests, you will develop software for neutron reflectometry or neutron spectroscopy, working closely with ESS scientists and users to define requirements and build tools that support research from data exploration to scientific interpretation.



At ESS and DMSC, you will work at the intersection of scientific research and software engineering in an international and collaborative environment. You will contribute to open\-source tools and modern workflows that researchers use to analyse and interpret neutron scattering data across the ESS instrument programme.



You will also collaborate with the DMSC data reduction team, which is responsible for processing raw detector data into analysis\-ready datasets. Your role will focus on the interactive analysis applications scientists use during and after experiments, improving the usability, functionality, and quality of scientific software at ESS.



Your will work on:


* Interactive scientific applications and user interfaces
* Jupyter\-based analysis pipelines
* Scientific visualisation and data exploration tools
* API and application design
* Improving usability, reliability, and maintainability
* Debugging scientific applications
* Contributing to shared frameworks and open\-source software


You will also contribute to modernising existing systems, improving testing and automation practices, and shaping technical decisions across the software stack.


**About you**

You have strong Python development experience and have built software used by real users. You are comfortable working with scientific computing, data analysis, or technically complex applications, and are familiar with modern development practices such as testing, CI/CD, and version control.



You enjoy collaborating with scientists and improving analysis tools while balancing scientific requirements with practical engineering decisions. You have experience delivering and maintaining production\-quality scientific software, making pragmatic technical decisions, and contributing to a collaborative engineering culture through mentoring and technical leadership.



Experience in neutron scattering, x\-ray science, reflectometry, or spectroscopy is valuable but not required. Familiarity with tools such as PyQt, PySide, QML, or Jupyter is also beneficial.


**What we offer**



DMSC is located on the DTU campus in Kongens Lyngby, north of Copenhagen, while the ESS neutron facility is based in Lund, Sweden. Together, they form a unique cross\-border scientific environment in the Øresund region.



You will join a dynamic and highly collaborative international workplace with colleagues representing nearly 60 nationalities across ESS and DMSC. We offer opportunities for professional development, and close interaction between computational science, instrumentation, and large\-scale experiments.



Benefits include 25 \+ 5 annual leave days in addition to public and company holidays, an attractive pension scheme, preventative healthcare benefits, and relocation support for international hires where applicable.



This is a full\-time, permanent position based in Kongens Lyngby, Denmark, and we need someone who can start as soon as practically possible.



Learn more about living and working in Scandinavia: https://ess.eu/living\-working\-scandinavia.


**For further information**



For information about the position, contact Torben Roland Nielsen, Group Leader for Data Analysis \& User Support (DAUS), at torben.nielsen@ess.eu.



For recruitment\-related questions, contact Recruitment Officer Janne Erwolter at janne.erwolter@ess.eu.


**How to apply**



Please submit your CV and cover letter no later than **26 August 2026**.



We look forward to receiving your application.

  


For more information regarding the ESS recruitment process in general, please follow this link: Careers \| ESS

jobs.description:
Twoday is the leading digital transformation partner in Northern Europe with a global presence. With approximately 3,000 specialists, we collaborate with some of the most admired private and public organisations to deliver cutting\-edge digital solutions. Our expertise spans software engineering, Data \& AI, cloud platforms, digital experiences and business applications.


We are now looking for a Senior Platform Engineer to help transform a large\-scale development and deployment platform from traditional DevOps into a modern AI\-assisted and agentic engineering setup.

**Permanent position at Twoday \| Copenhagen**

**Java Developer – Java, Spring \& Cloud\-Native Development**


Do you enjoy developing secure, scalable backend systems while continuously improving development processes?


You'll join an experienced development team responsible for business\-critical enterprise applications built on modern Java technologies.

**What you'll be doing**

* Developing and maintaining enterprise Java applications
* Building REST APIs and backend services using Java and Spring
* Developing containerised applications using Docker
* Working with Linux\-based environments
* Maintaining CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps
* Supporting the migration towards Kubernetes and cloud\-native architectures
* Working with Gradle and modern build processes
* Using AI\-assisted development tools for coding, testing and documentation
* Collaborating closely with architects, developers and DevOps engineers

* Strong professional Java development experience
* Experience with Spring Framework
* Experience with REST APIs
* Experience with Gradle
* Experience with Docker and Linux
* Experience with Azure DevOps, Git and CI/CD
* Experience with Kubernetes is an advantage
* Experience with AI\-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT or Cursor is an advantage
* Fluent Danish, both written and spoken, is a mandatory requirement

**Who you are**

* You enjoy solving complex technical challenges

* You enjoy collaborating in experienced development teams
* You are curious and continuously look for better ways of building software

**What we offer**


At Twoday, you'll become part of one of the leading digital transformation partners in the Nordics. As a permanent consultant, you'll work on long\-term, business\-critical public sector projects while continuing your professional development within Twoday's engineering community.

**Diversity \& inclusion**

At Twoday, we are committed to building a workplace and community where everyone is welcome. If you are excited about this role but your previous experience doesn’t perfectly align with the job description, we still encourage you to apply.

Erfaren Software Engineer til Advertisement & Partner Management i TV 2 Teknologi
jobs.description:
### **Vil du være med til at udvikle forretningskritiske løsninger, til salg og booking af reklamer på TV 2s platforme?**


Advertisement \& Partner Management i TV 2 Teknologi har stor betydning for TV 2s forretning, da en stor del af TV 2s indtjening afhænger af områdets løsninger. Teamet, du bliver en del af, arbejder med bruger\- og annoncørvendte løsninger, der hjælper annoncører, partnere og interne kolleger med at booke, planlægge og håndtere reklamer på TV 2s platforme.


Du bliver en del af et team, der videreudvikler eksisterende systemer, bygger integrationer og udvikler nye cloud\-baserede services. Vi står midt i en vigtig transformation, hvor vi skal forstå og udfordre det eksisterende og gradvist bevæge os mod nye arkitekturprincipper, andre teknologivalg, og brug af agenter, samtidig med at markedet for reklamesalg er i rivende udvikling.


Derfor søger vi dig, der skriver god kode, tager ansvar fra idé til drift og bidrager med friske øjne på arkitektur, teknologi og måden, vi løser opgaverne på.


### **Rollen**


Som Software Engineer kommer du til at arbejde tæt sammen med andre udviklere, arkitekter, product management og forretningen. Du får mulighed for at være med til at udvikle både konkrete løsninger og den tekniske retning for et område med høj prioritet.


Arbejdet handler både om at videreudvikle eksisterende løsninger og bygge nyt, når det giver mening. Vi bevæger os mod services i .NET/C\#, tydelige API’er og cloud\-baserede løsninger på AWS. Samtidig moderniserer vi forretningskritiske flows med omtanke, så de fortsat skaber værdi undervejs.


Dine primære opgaver bliver at:


* arbejde med arkitekturen i vores systemportefølje og bidrage til en mere serviceorienteret, cloud\-baseret og modulær retning med tydelige domæner, ansvar og snitflader.
* designe, udvikle og videreudvikle backend\-services og API’er.
* arbejde med integrationer, REST, messaging, databaser og forretningskritiske dataflows.
* tage ansvar for opgaver fra afklaring og udvikling til test, release og drift.
* bruge data, brugerindsigt og domæneforståelse til at udvikle løsninger, der rammer det reelle behov.
* anvende AI\-værktøjer og agentiske workflows som en naturlig del af softwareudviklingen – ansvarligt og i tråd med TV 2s politikker.

### **Teamet**


Du bliver en del af et tværfagligt team med software engineers, designere, product management og tæt kontakt til forretningen. Vi har stor indflydelse på både løsningerne og den retning, området udvikler sig i. Derfor forventer vi, at alle bidrager med idéer, udfordrer det eksisterende og tager ansvar for det, vi bygger.


Vi tager ikke os selv alt for højtideligt. Der er plads til idéer, en uformel omgangstone og masser af sparring i hverdagen. Vi tror på, at de bedste løsninger bliver skabt i fællesskab, og vi prioriterer videndeling, samarbejde og faglige diskussioner højt. Samtidig betyder det meget for os, at vi hjælper hinanden og har det godt sammen.


Du kommer til et team med høj faglighed, stor tillid og plads til at være dig selv – uanset om du har størst interesse for arkitektur, kode, domæneforståelse eller samarbejdet med mennesker.


Det primære arbejdssted er Teglholmen i København.


### **Din profil**


Vi forestiller os, at du har flere års erfaring som software engineer og trives med backend, integrationer, cloud, frontend og arkitektur. Du er bedst hjemme i backend og systemarkitektur, men har lyst til at bidrage bredt i teknologistakken, når teamet har brug for det.


Du kan udfordre eksisterende løsninger på en konstruktiv, velargumenteret og pragmatisk måde. Du tager initiativ og ejerskab fra A til Z og trives med, at vi nogle gange skal rykke hurtigt og træffe valg, selv om vi ikke har alle svar på forhånd. Samtidig har du lyst til at blive en del af teamet, dele viden og udvikle løsninger sammen med andre.


Vi forventer, at du:


* har solid erfaring med backend\-udvikling i .NET/C\#, og med at designe, bygge og videreudvikle services.
* har erfaring med integrationer, REST, messaging, samt microservice\- og API\-design.
* har arbejdet med et bredt udsnit af storage\-teknologier og forstår, hvornår de bør anvendes.
* har erfaring med cloud\-baserede løsninger, gerne i AWS, og kan vurdere, hvornår containers, serverless eller managed services giver mening.
* arbejder struktureret med Git, testautomatisering, release\-flow og løbende forbedring af kodekvalitet – med fokus på cyber security, resilience og observability.

Vi forestiller os, at du:


* har arbejdet med frontend\-udvikling i JavaScript/TypeScript, gerne React.
* har bred erfaring med forskellige typer programmeringssprog og teknologier, og kender deres fordele og begrænsninger.
* kan bruge AI\-værktøjer ansvarligt på tværs af software\-livscyklus, fra idé, analyse og design til udvikling, test, dokumentation og drift, og er nysgerrig på de næste skridt.

Vigtigst er, at du har lyst til at bidrage, forstå domænet og skabe løsninger, der skaber værdi for teamet, vores brugere og TV 2\.


### **TV 2 som teknologiarbejdsplads**


I TV 2s teknologiorganisation arbejder over 320 specialister hver dag med at udvikle hele den teknologiske værdikæde – fra avanceret medieteknologi og liveproduktion til digitale produkter som apps, streamingtjenester, dataløsninger og brugeroplevelser. Det er her, vi omsætter målet om personlig public service til konkrete løsninger, som møder danskernes behov på tværs af platforme.


Vi arbejder i tværfaglige teams – med bl.a. Software Engineers, UX\-designere, Agile Coaches, Enterprise Architects, Konfigurationsspecialister og Data Engineers – og vi har fokus på kvalitet, tilgængelighed, performance og sikkerhed i alt, hvad vi bygger og driver. Du får kolleger i både Odense på Kvægtorvet og i København på Teglholmen samt en kultur, hvor læring, videndeling og ansvar går hånd i hånd med dynamikken i Danmarks største mediehus.


### **Søg stillingen**


Du sender din ansøgning med CV via formularen nedenunder.Ansøgningsfristen er den 16\. august, 2026\. Samtaler afholdes løbende.


Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig!

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description:
**City:** Ballerup
**Country/Region:** Denmark
**State:****Business Area:** IT
**Department:** Data \& Analytics
**Employment Type:** Full\-time
**Req ID:** 10252
Do you want to help shape the future of data and analytics in a global MedTech company?  



Ambu is on an exciting digital transformation journey, investing heavily in our Enterprise Data Platform to strengthen data\-driven decision\-making across the business. We are looking for a **Data Engineer** to join our Data \& Analytics team at our headquarters in Denmark and play a key role in designing, building, and maintaining enterprise\-scale data solutions.  



Working with modern Microsoft technologies and cloud\-based solutions on Azure, you will collaborate with business stakeholders, solution architects, system managers, and fellow data professionals to deliver impactful solutions that support critical business processes across our global organization.  



This is a unique opportunity to combine your software engineering background with data engineering expertise while contributing to innovative healthcare solutions that improve patient care worldwide.  


**The role**  



As a Data Engineer, you will be involved in the design, development and support of solutions across Ambu's data landscape, including:
* Enterprise Data Warehouse solutions
* Master Data Management (MDM) solutions
* Data integrations and APIs
* Cloud\-based Azure data services
* Bespoke data solutions supporting various business functions

  


**Your key responsibilities will include:**
* Designing, developing and maintaining enterprise data solutions
* Building and supporting data integration pipelines and interfaces
* Collaborating with business stakeholders to understand and translate requirements into technical solutions
* Ensuring data quality, reliability and performance across the data platform
* Participating in project delivery, testing and solution deployment activities
* Supporting and enhancing existing data solutions
* Contributing to data governance, architecture and best practices
* Identifying opportunities to improve and modernize the data platform

  


**Suggested candidate profile**  



Setting you up for success is one of our cornerstones. We imagine you have a robust educational background in computer science, software engineering, data science, or a related field, combined with hands\-on experience building and supporting data solutions in a modern cloud environment.  



As a person, you are proactive, curious, collaborative, and motivated by solving complex business challenges through technology.  


**More specifically, you bring:*** Around 5 years of experience Data Engineering, Data Warehousing and Data Integration
* A background in Software Engineering and experience applying software development principles and best practices
* Strong SQL and data modelling skills
* Experience with Microsoft Azure data technologies and cloud services
* Experience developing ETL/ELT solutions, data pipelines, and integrations
* Knowledge of APIs and data integration patterns
* Understanding of Data Warehousing, Master Data Management (MDM), Data Quality, and Data Governance principles
* Experience with Python, C\# or similar programming languages
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills

  


**Please note that due to the upcoming summer holiday period, the recruitment process may take slightly longer than usual. We expect to begin the interview process in August.**  


**Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter**  



Ambu is a company that expands rapidly and has ambitious growth targets. We meet these targets through interdisciplinary teamwork between motivated and highly skilled employees. Your contributions and efforts are crucial to our success and by joining us you will get the opportunity to work in an international head office with an informal working environment.  



We offer great opportunities for personal development. Furthermore, we offer a wide range of professional, social and financial employee benefits in addition to exciting job challenges and continuous professional and personal development.  


About Ambu


Ambu has been bringing the solutions of the future to life since 1937\. Today, millions of patients and healthcare professionals worldwide depend on the efficiency, safety and performance of our single\-use endoscopy, anaesthesia, and patient monitoring solutions. We continuously look to the future with a commitment to deliver innovative quality products that have a positive impact on patient care and the work of healthcare professionals. Headquartered near Copenhagen in Denmark, Ambu employs approximately 4,500 people in Europe, North America and the Asia Pacific.


For more information, please visit ambu.com or follow us on LinkedIn.
